role: Data Analytics Manager (Medior BI Developer / Data Analyst)

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement and maintain data governance best practices to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data governance and quality signals appear alongside startup-vibe, fast-moving team framing ('startup vibe', 'pioneer new approaches') with roughly equal weight, giving mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: converting this complex raw data (from Google, Meta, TikTok, ad servers, CRM, and more) into crystal-clear, scalable, and visually impressive Power BI solutions
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect marketing/media strategy decisions for large brand clients without regulatory or financial-reporting consequence, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Engineers; Solution Architects; Product Owners; media specialists; project managers
evidence.data_team_maturity: Within the DIO team, we are building the data technology of tomorrow. We are a multidisciplinary team with a startup vibe, backed by the scaling power of the global WPP network.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Multiple named roles (Data Engineers, Solution Architects, Product Owners) and an existing Snowflake-based pipeline in responsibilities signal mid maturity within a larger enterprise network.
evidence.jd_authorship: Where the engineers ensure the data lands in our Snowflake data warehouse (via Adverity), you take the baton: modeling, building, and visualizing.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools (Power BI, DAX, Adverity, Snowflake) and precise handoff points in the pipeline, giving a clear picture of day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: You create dashboards that directly impact the strategies of the world's largest brands.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves marketing/media performance dashboards for brand clients and internal media specialists, making commercial the dominant orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: You can support the Project Manager by outlining projects, providing estimations, and providing updates on progress.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities are framed as supporting and delivering against requirements gathered from stakeholders and engineers rather than setting direction, giving execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The company description mentions an 'AI-driven media operating unit' and 'agentic marketing platform' but no AI skill or responsibility is expected of this specific candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Monitor and troubleshoot data quality issues, ensuring timely resolution.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data governance and quality monitoring are framed as an owned responsibility (implement and maintain, monitor and troubleshoot) with action verbs, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Implement and maintain data governance best practices to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance and accuracy framing is present but secondary to the primary dashboard-delivery and stakeholder-service mission, consistent with moderate loss aversion.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Embrace challenges and pioneer new approaches to BI development within the team, setting the foundation for future practices.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both builds new BI approaches/foundations (greenfield) and maintains/optimizes existing dashboards and data models (fix/scale), giving mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexibility: Work-from-home options, flexible working hours... Hybrid Working Allowance: €30 net per month
evidence.loss_aversion: Monitor and troubleshoot data quality issues, ensuring timely resolution. — reliability framed as an operational task rather than a dominant risk register.

responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Ensure dashboards provide clear, actionable insights that aligns with marketing- and media objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into effective visualizations.
You can support the Project Manager by outlining projects, providing estimations, and providing updates on progress.
Develop and maintain robust Power BI data models, including DAX calculations. Support on complex data transformations.
Familiar with data warehouse models like snowflake scheme
Optimize data models for performance and usability.
Ensure data models are aligned with business rules and logic.
Able to support on extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data from various marketing and media data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, Jarvis meta data, media platforms, CRM systems and other).
Integrate and consolidate data to provide a unified view of marketing and media performance.
Work closely with media specialists, project managers, product & AI engineers, and data engineers to understand their needs and deliver BI solutions that meet expectations.
Provide training and support to end-users on how to use BI tools and dashboards effectively.
Provide consultancy to clients on how to use, construct & interpretate data solutions
Present findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
Implement and maintain data governance best practices to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
Monitor and troubleshoot data quality issues, ensuring timely resolution.
Able to manage own projects (agile and with the usage of project management tools like Wrike) according to our quality principles
Stay updated with the latest BI technologies and global company and industry trends, particularly in the marketing and media sectors.
Identify opportunities to enhance BI processes and solutions to better support business objectives.
Embrace challenges and pioneer new approaches to BI development within the team, setting the foundation for future practices.
